senses.gloss:
ITA-9.8.10 medhyarasāyanam मेध्यरसायनम्
Rejuvenation therapy to enhance mental abilities
Rejuvenation therapy or medicines beneficial for increasing intellect.

ITA-9.8.11 medhyāyuṣyakāmīyarasāyanam मेध्यायुष्यकामीयरसायनम्
Mental ability and lifespan enhancer
Therapies or medicines which enhance intellect and improve longevity.
